description: Source code implementing ASN.1 encoding/decoding and comparison functions for RSA keys in OpenSSL, including functions for encoding, decoding, comparison, size, and freeing RSA keys, as well as defining an EVP_PKEY_ASN1_METHOD structure for RSA.

methods.name: rsa_pub_encode
methods.description: Encodes RSA public key into ASN.1 format following RFC 3279.

methods.name: rsa_pub_decode
methods.description: Decodes ASN.1 formatted RSA public key into EVP_PKEY structure.

methods.name: rsa_pub_cmp
methods.description: Compares two RSA public keys for equality based on modulus and exponent.

methods.name: rsa_priv_encode
methods.description: Encodes RSA private key into ASN.1 format following RFC 3447.

methods.name: rsa_priv_decode
methods.description: Decodes ASN.1 formatted RSA private key into EVP_PKEY structure.

methods.name: rsa_opaque
methods.description: Checks if RSA key is opaque.

methods.name: int_rsa_size
methods.description: Returns size of RSA key in bytes.

methods.name: rsa_bits
methods.description: Returns number of bits in RSA key.

methods.name: int_rsa_free
methods.description: Frees RSA key within EVP_PKEY structure.
